checks.name: clear result prioritizes home and demotes revisit
result actions are outside the scrolling result body
opening a window retains the result scroll position
records explain their role and separate targets from cards
known target shows actual initial card counts and a separate observation section
private composition, evidence ids and next-card predictions are not exposed
observations do not fabricate an unknown initial catalogue
card records are labelled as known performance, not inventory
card detail returns directly to the same records category
capacity use and per-skill cost have different labels
skill details have separate condition and effect fields
skill details keep the exact public condition/effect, without inferred rules
learning and equipment actions remain outside the scrolling detail body
open/close uses the same16:9 height request at 1024 (no painting)
resize preserves the open detail and shared draft at 1024
open/close uses the same16:9 height request at 736 (no painting)
resize preserves the open detail and shared draft at 736
open/close uses the same16:9 height request at 600 (no painting)
resize preserves the open detail and shared draft at 600
open/close uses the same16:9 height request at 320 (no painting)
resize preserves the open detail and shared draft at 320
multiple pinned/detail windows do not increase the frame height request
comparison keeps confirm actions outside the scroll body
structured detail changes can still commit through the real API
unresolved withdrawal prioritizes retry and keeps home available
retry reaches a real new attempt without requiring a hub detour
frame/overlay/scroll layout rules exist without scale transforms
no script errors

conditions: Real Campaign and original MemoryStore; natural clear-return and port saves.
JSDOM with explicit resize/visibility callbacks; heights are requested CSS pixel values, not painted rectangles.
limits: No rendered-browser aspect/overflow or physical scroll/reachability verification.
No IndexedDB, touch or user acceptance.
The prior32 journey checks are historical and were not rerun merely for handoff.
